FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 27
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Chris England
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/15/2024
House Bill 27 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of: (1) certain courts
for hearing petitions for re-sentencing of certain individuals sentenced to death; and (2) the
Administrative Office of Courts to adopt rules to implement the provisions of this bill. This bill
would also prohibit the charging of a filing fee for such a petition.
